title: CS0246 on a primary-constructor parameter type means a missing using, not a missing type
symptoms: CS0246: The type or namespace name '...' could not be found
explanation: When adding a primary constructor that references a type from another namespace (e.g. IOptions<T>), CS0246 almost always means the corresponding `using` directive is missing — not that the type doesn't exist. Add the using before investigating package references.
